CANONICAL_NAME.value: python-sgp4 2.23 -- Vallado's SGP4/SDP4 satellite propagator (C++ core + Python), with the official test vectors (Brandon Rhodes)

value.lineage: Simplified General Perturbations model 4 (Hoots & Roehrich, Spacetrack Report #3, 1980) as revised by Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak & Kelso (AIAA 2006-6753) -- the propagator behind every Two-Line Element set. Orbital mechanics under Earth oblateness, drag and lunar-solar resonance; the package embeds Vallado's C++ and ships tcppver.out, the reference trajectories every implementation must reproduce.

value.built_to: predict where a satellite will be from a compact element set, fast enough for thousands of objects, accurately enough to point an antenna
value.pressure: Earth oblateness, atmospheric drag, deep-space resonances; a legacy element format whose meaning is defined by this very algorithm
value.success_means: trajectories reproduce the reference vectors to the published tolerance

value.pressure: perturbations (drag, oblateness), precision, compatibility with a 1980 data format
value.failure_condition: a term or unit slip puts the predicted position kilometres off and the antenna misses

value: algorithm_from: Hoots & Roehrich 1980; Vallado et al. 2006

cut.note: an analytic orbit propagator: a two-line element set is a MEAN element set defined by this model, so the propagator is the coordinate system's own definition; the code is a line-by-line port of Vallado's C++ (comments preserved as '// sgp4fix ...'), with two regime switches (simplified drag below 220 km perigee; deep-space corrections for periods over 225 minutes), a capped Newton iteration for Kepler's equation, and domain checks that return error codes instead of numbers

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: sgp4() 'update for secular gravity and atmospheric drag' block; satrec.isimp (sgp4init 1421-1423: perigee < 220 km -> isimp = 1 drops the d2..d4, t3cof..t5cof terms)
organs.mechanism: at time tsince the mean anomaly, argument of perigee and node are advanced by their secular rates (J2, J4 gravity) and drag terms in powers of tsince up to t^5 whose coefficients were precomputed at initialisation; for perigees below 220 km the higher-order drag polynomial is switched off (isimp) because the series is not trusted there; below 156 km the density-model parameters s and qoms2t are altered (1429-1432)
organs.input: the initialised satrec; tsince in minutes
assumptions: the perturbation series truncated at these orders is the definition of the element set (Spacetrack Report 3, 1980); accuracy is measured against the same model's reference implementation, not against truth
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: milliseconds per propagation for every catalogued object; the element sets are only meaningful under this exact arithmetic
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the 'sgp4fix' comments (divide-by-zero on inclination, tolerance changes, decay detection) are the recorded failure landscape of thirty years of use; every fix is a line comment
organs.human_prior: Hoots & Roehrich 1980; Vallado et al. 2006 (the AIAA revision this port follows)
organs.source_boundary: the secular block; MEDIUM because the coefficient derivations were not read

organs.human_name: sgp4init 1495-1499 (2 pi / no_unkozai >= 225 -> method 'd', isimp 1); _dscom, _dsinit, _dspace (secular resonance integration), _dpper (long-period periodics)
organs.mechanism: for orbital periods of 225 minutes or more the near-earth model is insufficient: initialisation computes lunar and solar perturbation coefficients (_dscom, _dsinit) and flags synchronous or half-day resonances (irez); propagation then integrates the resonance terms numerically in fixed steps (_dspace) and adds long-period lunar-solar periodics to the elements (_dpper); the same call path serves both regimes with method == 'd' as the switch
organs.state: the resonance integrator's state (atime, xli, xni) carried in satrec
organs.update: per call, stepping from the last integrated time
assumptions: 225 minutes is the boundary where third-body and resonance effects exceed the near-earth truncation error (an SDP4 convention, not derived here)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: one propagator for LEO and GEO catalogues
organs.failure_landscape: UNKNOWN by run; the tcppver oracle covers both regimes
organs.source_boundary: the 'd' method path; CANDIDATE because the deep-space bodies were not read

organs.human_name: sgp4() 'sgp4fix for kepler iteration': while fabs(tem5) >= 1.0e-12 and ktr <= 10
organs.mechanism: the eccentric anomaly is found from the mean longitude by Newton's method on Kepler's equation in the (axnl, aynl) long-period form; the correction tem5 is clamped to +/-0.95 per step (the 'sgp4fix'); at most ten iterations, stopping when the correction is below 1e-12
assumptions: Newton converges in a few steps for e < 1; the clamp prevents divergence for near-parabolic cases (test_hyperbolic_orbit exists)
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: ten iterations without convergence is silently accepted (no error code)

organs.human_name: satrec.error 1-6: mean motion < 0 (2), eccentricity outside [1e-6, 1) (1), perturbed eccentricity out of range (3), semilatus rectum < 0 (4), mrt < 1 decayed (6)
organs.mechanism: after each stage the elements are range-checked; a violation sets an integer code and a message on the record and returns (false, false) instead of a position; code 6 (radius below one earth radius) marks a decayed object and is set but the position is still returned
assumptions: callers check the code; the propagator never raises
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a catalogue run does not stop on one bad element set

pressures.condition: an organism receives mean elements fitted by the reference model and must output positions; the score is agreement with the reference implementation's outputs (tcppver.out), not with observed positions; edge regimes (low perigee, deep space, near-parabolic) exist in the test set
pressures.resource_or_constraint: milliseconds per call; no numerical integrator
pressures.failure_condition: disagreement with the reference beyond the tolerance on any catalogue object, or an exception on a degenerate set
pressures.world_punishes: a physically better propagator (it disagrees with the elements' definition)
pressures.world_rewards: faithful reproduction of the truncated series and its fixes
pressures.observable_consequence: max position error vs tcppver.out across SGP4-VER.TLE with each 'sgp4fix' reverted one at a time
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: calling the C++ extension (the same arithmetic; the world must run the Python path)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism handed tcppver.out must match exactly; a numerical two-body integrator must FAIL the comparison (it is more physical and less faithful): the world must show both, which is the point
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: TLE propagation (Vallado 2006 revision of SGP4/SDP4)
